title: Karla Turner's abductees describe a control system run from a metallic sphere (the Moon)

tellings.quote: where they said that we are in a control system that's being managed from out of a metallic sphere just beyond the earth.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani says that abductees studied by Karla Turner, an author who wrote about abduction cases in the 1990s, described people on Earth as living inside a control system run from a metallic sphere just beyond the planet, which Jorjani takes to be the Moon. He connects this with Far Journeys, a book by Robert Monroe, a writer on out-of-body experiences. If true, it would mean humanity is being managed from close by in space.
